body.intent: Fix A queued continuation can wait far longer than its slot should take: run 01M6WMX236BTT04TYQDACGKBZ4 (autonomy per workflow, PR #376 green) was queued with rhiza run resume at 2026-11-08T08:09Z and was still not started at 09:24Z; daemon status listed it as 'interrupted' among the live runs next to 3 running ones at rhiza.daemon.maxRuns 3, while two plain starts were 'waiting for a slot'. Check whether an interrupted run with a queued continuation counts against the cap itself (so it needs live <= cap-1 to start), and whether continuations take the next free slot ahead of new starts as #226/#243 intend. Unstuck by driving it with rhiza run resume --foreground.
